entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add async versions of the design-time operations #37351
    Backlog
  • Unexpected migration code when making complex property optional #37349
  • Unexpected behavior for non-optional complex type where all properties are nullable in included optional property #37346
  • EFCore 10 - Scaffolding - Index created on views not getting scaffolded #37345

Closed

  • Unexpected behavior for non-optional complex type where all properties are nullable in included property with inmemory #37348
  • OPENJSON fallback not applied when multiple collections exceed 2100 parameter limit #37347
